replacements.note: Produced by a CLI tool but written into a POST BODY, so it is content: every visitor who opens that thread reads it, forever. Translated in the locale the importer runs under (the default_locale setting — Console has no SetLocale middleware), which for this forum is Spanish. See `deferred` for what a per-reader version would take.

deferred.string: the three content strings above, considered as PER-READER text
deferred.reason: The replacements above fix the language but not the mechanism: these strings are frozen into the row at import time, so a reader who switches the forum to English still sees them in the importer's locale. Making them per-reader means writing a marker instead of a sentence — a BBCode tag such as [IMPORTNOTE kind=nobody] emitted here, with the template and the wording owned by looksmax-format (which already renders every other import artefact: [umention], [hideposts], [deleted]) and localised through the same XSL-parameter hook described in looksmax-format/locale/i18n-map.json. That crosses two extensions and rewrites already-imported rows (`lmx:import --reconvert` exists and would carry it), so it is a deliberate decision, not a patch. 'Untitled' cannot be done this way at all: a discussion title is a plain column, not formatter XML.

notes.not_translatable: All five audit findings in src/HtmlToBbcode.php (:518 '\n[unfurl url="', :627 '[emote name="', :790 '\n[embed site=', :928 '[gmention name="', :1002 '[umention name="') are BBCode tags the converter emits into the stored source text. They are syntax, and the audit's own bbcode-definition rule excludes the identical strings on the looksmax-format side; translating one would produce an unparseable post. Read the whole converter for prose: it emits none. src/Console/ImportCommand.php's ->info() / ->error() output and the 21 option descriptions are operator-facing CLI, correctly excluded. 'user'.$srcId (ImportCommand.php:790) is a generated username, an identifier, not a label.
